system.description:
You release a surge of chakra from yourself attempting to remove the sight, Sound, and Tactile senses of all creatures in a 30 Foot Radius centering on you. Each creature in this jutsu’s affected area or when a creature enters the affected area for the first time on their turn, must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Creatures who fail remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this jutsu’s effect on them on a success.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Blinded until the end of their next turn..

Failure: Affected creatures are Blinded, Deafened and unable to feel physical touch for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same as Failure, but they are also Confused for the duration.
